scope: Isolated Marcher-only phases and prepared fields/orbs; no full-round, full-match or complete Lord-effect integration.
source_state: Uncommitted implementation on the named base. Fingerprint covers Godot/Python source; input JSON is separately hashed. Documentation and the shell runner are outside that broad fingerprint; file hashes are also retained here.
godot_stage_timing_scope: Export, independent replay and transport checks; not Godot phase-throughput timing.

trace_identity.scope: isolated phases; explicit fields/actors; no Lord reactions

timing_report.scope: three isolated 200-tick phases; ordinary/dense/Gravity inputs; no full game or doctrine

phase_modes.batch_phase: public resolve; includes validation, import, all rule events and final publication; excludes MARCHING_TICK recording
phase_modes.trace_phase: same public resolve plus all 200 exact tick frames
phase_modes.phase_prepare: owned context copy and validated column import only
phase_modes.prepared_batch_work: phase.run after preparation; includes tick work, rule events and final publication

timing_report.layout_scope: validated import and publication only; RowBoundary is not a competing optimized row-based tick kernel
timing_report.memory_scope: deduplicated reachable Python object bytes; neither process RSS nor incremental allocator usage
